title: Ropes & Gray Professor of Law, Emeritus
bio: Alvin C. Warren is the Ropes & Gray Professor of Law Emeritus at Harvard Law School, where he taught tax law and policy from 1979 to 2024. Prior to Harvard, Professor Warren was a member of the law faculties of the University of Connecticut, Duke University, and the University of Pennsylvania. He has also been […]
